first_action: Keep sitemap, robots, canonical, IndexNow, GSC, and Bing verification healthy
why_it_exists: Search takes time but creates durable discovery evidence
success_signal: Indexed URLs, impressions, query breadth, and crawler access
stop_or_rewrite_rule: Do not publish more pages only because sitemap or IndexNow succeeds

first_action: Post concise progress notes that include shipped artifact, before-after change, and evidence gap
why_it_exists: New sites need visible work history before trust exists
success_signal: Profile visits, page clicks, replies, and qualified objections
stop_or_rewrite_rule: Rewrite if posts describe effort but not a buyer problem
privacy_boundary: Do not publish private replies or payment identifiers

first_action: Keep repo, update log, route registry, templates, and checks inspectable
why_it_exists: Technical buyers and AI agents can verify the system from artifacts
success_signal: Repository visits, copied templates, issue requests, and source links
stop_or_rewrite_rule: Stop if repo only shows code without usage examples
privacy_boundary: No customer data in public repo

first_action: Answer narrow questions about AI service offers, launch validation, AI crawler readiness, and route selection
why_it_exists: The site needs demand-led entry points rather than broad promotion
success_signal: Helpful replies, referral clicks, and repeated question patterns
stop_or_rewrite_rule: Stop if replies become generic promotion instead of solving the question
privacy_boundary: Follow community rules; no automated posting

first_action: Send small batches to AI-capable builders with the Fit Review sample and no guarantee claims
why_it_exists: Payment proof will not appear without targeted human contact
success_signal: Qualified replies, sample views, confirmed payment, usable intake
stop_or_rewrite_rule: Stop after 20 targeted prospects with no qualified reply and rewrite the offer

first_action: Ask builders, SEO operators, and AI workflow sellers to critique the sample and route method
why_it_exists: External critique finds unclear value before paid traffic
success_signal: Specific objections, wording fixes, and referral offers
stop_or_rewrite_rule: Stop if reviewers cannot explain the product after reading the sample
privacy_boundary: Do not store names or private comments publicly

first_action: Submit only after the route method, sample, pricing, and trust pages are stable
why_it_exists: Listings can create first non-search visits but weak products waste the launch window
success_signal: Referral visits and qualified sample views
stop_or_rewrite_rule: Delay if the homepage or pricing page still cannot explain the paid outcome
